column3: Upon the CityCenter (Aria & Vdara) Mortgage Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the BX 2025-ARIA TSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the BX 2025-ARIA TSA will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to the Mortgage Loan accruing at a rate equal to 0.15% per annum.
